items.title: The not-word fills one slot
items.caption: The tense particle, verb, and doer keep their order. The not-word enters between the particle and the verb.

items.title: Deny a habit or deny this moment
items.caption: The bare not-word under the general particle denies the habit. Adding the short happening-now particle denies what is under way now.

items.title: Sort not and not yet
items.intro: Place each complete printed sentence under the kind of negative it uses.

items.why: The not-word denies the matching past statement.
The not-word denies the lasting quality.

items.en: The girl has not gone yet.
items.why: The event has not happened so far but is still expected.
The not-yet word follows the general particle after the pronoun.
